lastCompletedStory.title: Graceful token-ceiling degradation for the codex backend

nextStoryContext: The CAM-5 per-worker token-ceiling backstop in loop.ts is now backend-aware. New pure predicate shouldApplyTokenCeiling(backend: string, maxWorkerTokens: number, hasReader: boolean): boolean (exported from src/supervisor/loop.ts, placed right before MAX_DEAD_WORKER_RETRIES) returns `backend !== 'codex' && maxWorkerTokens > 0 && hasReader`: everything that is not literally 'codex' (including unknown/future backend strings) still enforces the ceiling, matching selectAdapter's own defensive-default posture (US-002). The poll loop's condition changed from `if (maxWorkerTokens > 0 && readWorkerTokens)` to `if (applyTokenCeiling && readWorkerTokens)` (the local is computed once per dispatch, right before the `while (true)` poll loop, from `implBackend` which was already being read at that point). When applyTokenCeiling is false SPECIFICALLY because the backend is 'codex' (i.e. a ceiling WAS configured and a reader WAS wired, but codex can't use it), a new one-time event kind 'worker-token-ceiling-unavailable' fires (once per dispatch, before the poll loop starts, not per poll tick) via the existing `emit(...)` helper, carrying `{ backend, ceiling }` in its detail (new WorkerTokenCeilingUnavailableEventDetail interface, src/supervisor/events.ts, added to the WorkerEventKind union and the WorkerEventDetail union). This never throws and never silently drops the gap: codex workers with maxWorkerTokens=0 (ceiling not configured at all) emit nothing (correctly, since there is no gap to report), matching the same 'disabled ceiling' semantics claude already had. The claude path (and any non-codex backend) is byte-identical: same condition truth table, same event, same kill behavior -- verified by the two pre-existing CAM-5 tests (kill-on-breach, disabled-when-0) passing unmodified. Testing gotcha for the NEXT story that needs to drive readPhaseBackend('implementer') to a specific value inside a runSupervisor(...) test: there is NO configPath seam threaded through RunSupervisorOptions for this call site (unlike readPhaseModel/readPhaseBackend themselves, which do accept a configPath arg) -- the working pattern (see the new loop.test.ts codex-ceiling test) is mkdtempSync a scratch dir, write scripts/cam/project.toml with the desired [backend] section under it, process.chdir() into it for the duration of the test (restore cwd in finally), and if the codex path is exercised, also stage a stub .claude/agents/subagent-<actor>.md at that cwd (CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv reads it via writeCodexInstructionsFile and throws ENOENT otherwise). Remaining gap, called out in ADR-0047 and unchanged by this story: there is still no real codex usage/transcript parser (F3, future slice) -- this story only closes the 'never crashes / never silently drops' half of the risk ADR-0047's Consequences section flagged, not the 'codex ceiling actually enforced' half.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal supervisor-loop wiring: a pure predicate function plus a new structured event kind. No new external library surface touched (readWorkerTokens/transcript parsing itself was untouched -- only its call-site gating changed).
